(75)na mo gu ru bhyaḥskal ba dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bla ma'i 'dra 'bag yod na'ang bkram la/maṇḍal 'bul zhing yi ge brgya pa

tei:div.tei:p: na mo gu ru bhyaḥ skal ba dang ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bla ma'i 'dra 'bag yod na'ang bkram la/ maṇḍal 'bul zhing yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs ba'i 'og tu/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed la/ āḥ chos rnams bdag med nam mkha'i ngang*/ bde stong sgyu ma'i rol pa las/ sna tshogs padma zla ba'i steng*/ hūm̐ las bdag nyid rdo rje sems/ dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rab dgyes zhal 'jum mdangs dang ldan/ phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'jin/ g.yon pas dril bu dku la brten/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs/ rin po che dang dar gyis brgyan/ snang la rang bzhin med pa'i sku/ mu med 'od zer 'phro ba yi/ spyi gtsug sna tshogs padma dang*/ dri med zla ba nyi ma'i dbus/ skye med rang byung yi ge a/ yongs gyur skad cig dran rjogs su/ gu ru dri med bshes gnyen ni/ ljang ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ ting nge 'jin gyi phyag rgya (76)can/ 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum pa rnams/ paṇa zhwa chos gos rnam gsum gsol/ paṇḍi ta yi cha byad can/ rdo rje'i skyil krung mi g.yo bzhugs/ mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs par gsalal/ rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*/ dbyer med du ma ro gcig gsal/ thugs las 'od zer rab 'phros te/ shar phyogs ri bo rtse lnga nas/ bla ma mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas/ dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ bdag nyid dam tshig sems dpar thim/ snang srid thams cad 'od du 'bar/ thams cad lha dang lha mo'i zhing*/ kun kyang rdo rje'i glu gar bsgyur/ mchod pa'i char chen 'beb par bsam/ bla ma'i sku las 'od zer dang*/ 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ rang gi spyi gtsug rkang mthil bar/ khyab pas sgo gsum dri ma dag zag med bde bas lus gang nas/ dbang dang dngos grub thob par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru bi ma la badzra sa twa dharmā kā ya siddhi hūm̐/

zhes ci nus bzlas pa'i thun 'jog khar/ rig 'jin bla ma 'khor dang bcas/ phyi nang snod bcud bdag la (77)thim/ gzhi rjogs gnyug ma'i dbyings su yal/ brjod bral lhan cig skye pa'i ngang*/ āḥ zhes dgongs pa'i rgyun bskyang ngo*/ rjes la sems can don la bsngo ba smon lam bya'o/ zhes byin rlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma sgrub pa'i rim pa zhig dgos zhes lcags mo rong pa mchog sprul 'gyur med rdo rje'i bskul ngor chos smra ba'i btsun pa tshul khrims rgya mtshos bris pa dge'o/ ༈ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag bla ma rdo rje sems/ ye shes sgyu ma'i skur snang bī ma la/ theg mchog bstan pa'i shing rta klong chen pa/ dbyer med ngag gi dbang por gsol 'debs/ gter mjod dbang gi skabs mchod lcam mang po'i ngor mkhan ming pas phul/ gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang chos kyi rje/ rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsha'i khyab bdag mchog rgyal ba'i sras po padma las 'brel rtsal/ bka' drin mtshungs med khyed la gsol ba 'debs/ smin byed dbang gi chu bos rgyud smin nas/ (78)grol byed lam gyis snang bzhi mthar phyin te/ don brgyud dgongs pa'i byin rlabs sems la phobs/ rigs stong gdod ma'i dbyings su ro gcig shog ces pa'ang tshe dbang 'gyur med mos ngor padma las 'brel gyis so/ ༈ rigs kun khyab bdag rdo rje sems/ gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor rnams/ spro zhing sdud pa khyed gcig pu/ rig 'jin mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ don brgyud dgongs pas byin gyis rlobs/ sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med par/ sa lam bsgrod pa mthar phyin nas/ kun bzang chos sku'i rgyal khab tu/ rang rig don gyi bla ma dang*/ gnyis med 'bras bu mthar phyin te/ phrin las gdul bya'i dpal 'bar nas/ mkha' khyab 'gro ba 'dren par shog ces pa'ang tshe dbang 'gyur med ngor mkhan ming pas spel ba dge'o/// /
